data.explanation: This is the contract summary (Vertragszusammenfassung) for your new mobile plan. The minimum term is 12 months from activation. To end the contract at the end of that term, you need to give 1 month's notice. After the minimum term, the contract runs indefinitely and can be cancelled at any time with 1 month's notice. The app calculates the cancellation deadline from these terms. Nothing needs to be paid or returned now. Keep this letter with your contract records.
